taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station Odufor, Etche LGA survey stations. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 20.32 | 0.13606 | 0.13606
2 | 851.16 | 1.1039 | 1.2399
3 | 2511.9 | 15.803 | 17.043
4 | 1345 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as AK-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station Odufor, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Note – Station Odufor, Etche LGA**

The VES interpretation at Station Odufor resolves four layers. The top layer is a low-resistivity unit (20.32 Ω·m, 0.136 m thick), overlain sequence continuing into a moderately resistive second layer (851.16 Ω·m, 1.10 m thick, base at 1.24 m), followed by a high-resistivity third layer (2511.9 Ω·m, 15.80 m thick, base at 17.04 m), and terminating in a relatively lower-resistivity basal layer (1345 Ω·m, unbounded).

Applying the curve-type rule: layers 1-2-3 show r1 < r2 < r3 (A-type), and layers 2-3-4 show r2 < r3 > r4 (K-type). This gives a combined curve type of AK, consistent with the on-file classification. No discrepancy was found between the resistivity values and the stated curve type.

{"curve_type_stated": "AK", "label_issue_flagged": false}
